people.name: Aijalon
people.line: A Levitical city in Dan, site of Joshua's miracle.

people.name: Amorites
people.line: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel

people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.

people.name: Israel

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Then Joshua spoke to Yahweh in the day when Yahweh delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel. He said in the sight of Israel, “Sun, stand still on Gibeon! You, moon, stop in the valley of Aijalon!”
translations.bsb: On the day that the LORD gave the Amorites over to the Israelites, Joshua spoke to the LORD in the presence of Israel: “O sun, stand still over Gibeon, O moon, over the Valley of Aijalon.”
translations.kjv: Then spake Joshua to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.
translations.asv: Then spake Joshua to Jehovah in the day when Jehovah delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel; and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; And thou, Moon, in the valley of Aijalon.
